oracle: Fixed before application execution and checked independently with a balance-delta journal. Each payment observes base balance plus earlier journal entries; any first error discards the journal, while success commits all deltas at once. Commands are parsed only after every declared batch row has been consumed. Final account names are ordered by ASCII bytes. All 14 archived expectations and manually checked rollback/upper-bound traces agree. Application output never determines expectations.
scope: Only published valid ASCII/LF inputs: empty input allowed; at most 200 commands, with batch payment rows excluded from the command count; batch K in 0..100; names [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,15}; initial balances and transfer amounts in 0..1000000000 with leading zeros allowed. Blank command lines are ignored; batch payment rows are nonempty and syntactically valid.
